title: New Horizons in Music: Polyrhythms | Loop
summary: Adam Neely's Ableton Loop 2017 talk links rhythm, pitch and synaesthesia. He shows that polyrhythms sped up become chords, so tempo and pitch are related by ratios.
why: Commenters recommend it for the mind-blowing connection between rhythm and pitch and as an approachable intro to music theory.

quote.text: Highly recommend Adam's channel if you're interested in music/music theory.
